name: Wishbone - 22 Smash

QB.rule: Open right, hand to the fullback, then fake the boot left. It holds the backside end.

FB.rule: Take the handoff downhill between the center and the right guard. Do not bounce it.

LH.rule: Run hard to the left like you have the ball. You are what holds the backside.

coaching_points: The fullback is the runner here, not the lead. The hole is the A-gap — between the center and the right guard.
The right halfback leads through that gap. If the fullback bounces, the play is dead.
